MOINENMAPS.Water.title: Water
MOINENMAPS.Water.noPaint: Nothing painted yet. Pick a water tool and paint on the map.
MOINENMAPS.Water.empty: This scene has no water yet. Create it here, or pick a water tool and paint.
MOINENMAPS.Water.clearConfirm: Erase everything painted on this scene's water masks?
MOINENMAPS.Water.sec.mouth: Mouth (where the river goes over an edge)
MOINENMAPS.Water.a.allHint: Fades all the water at once, on top of the opacity of each part below.
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.fxOn: Rings, splash and wake around tokens that stand in or cross the water (a light layer: no new bake)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.fxStrength: How big and bright the effects are
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.fxRings: Rings spreading around a token that stands in the water
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.fxSplash: A splash when a token enters or leaves the water
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.fxWake: Foam behind a token that moves through the water (carried by the current)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectOn: A mirror image under every token, shown only where there is water (a light layer: no new bake). Meant for side and oblique views
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectType: A mirror image of the token, or a dark shadow of its shape
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectOffset: Gap between the token's feet and the reflection, in art pixels (negative: overlapping)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectLength: How much of the token is reflected (%)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectFade: How much the reflection fades with distance from the token
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectTint: How much the reflection takes the water's colour
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.submergeOn: A token with an elevation below zero that stands in water is veiled by the water, with bubbles rising from it (a light layer: no new bake)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.submergeStrength: How strongly the water veils the token
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.submergeDepth: The elevation (in scene units, below zero) at which the token is wholly veiled
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectBlurType: The shape of the blur: boxes of different sizes, a hard one weighing the centre, ones smearing left or up, and two diagonals
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectRipple: Rows slide sideways on a wave that grows toward the bottom and loops with the water
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectAmp: How far the rows slide at most
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectSpeed: Waves per loop of the water
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectScan: Every row jumps sideways by its own random amount
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflectScanValue: The most a row jumps, in art pixels
MOINENMAPS.Water.rod.kindHint: Flow rods steer the water; lip rods draw the edge a fall goes over
MOINENMAPS.Water.rod.branchHint: The next drag from a rod grows a branch (or hold Alt)
MOINENMAPS.Water.rod.reverseHint: The selected rod the other way round
MOINENMAPS.Water.rodsHint: Rods are bendable lines you draw on the map with the rod tool. Drag on the water for a new rod (the water runs the way you drag). Drag a dot to bend it, the line for a new dot, Shift-drag an end dot to grow it, Alt-drag the line for a branch. Right-click a dot or the line to remove it.
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.clean: Flat tones and edges of whole pixels instead of the grainy classic texture
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.cleanSize: How big the zones, lines, stones and net are drawn (0: automatic, by the picture's size)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.shallows: How wide the light shallows along the shore are
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.dither: A checkerboard where two zones meet (0 to 3 px)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.palBase: The water's own tone; the other five are made from it
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.palHue: How far the darker tones turn toward blue and the lighter ones toward yellow
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.palSat: How much the tones' saturation moves
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.palRange: How wide the spread from dark to light is (% of the usual)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.lap: 0 off, 1 a shimmering shore line, higher: lapping foam
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.waves: Wave lines rolling in to the shore (0 to 3)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.shade: The dark band under top banks (rivers too)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.sparkle: Little glints on the water and the falls
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.net: The net of light on still and pooled water: it wobbles in place, or slides where a fall feeds the pool
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.patches: Darker patches: whole cells of the net, or with no net round spots that swell and shrink
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.depth: Darker deep water away from the shore
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.drift: Speed of still water's own flow (0: still)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.angle: Direction of still water's flow, in degrees
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.tide: Still water climbs past its mask and falls back, leaving the ground wet
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.tideAmp: How many px the tide climbs past the mask (it never goes below it)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.tideUneven: 0: the whole shore at once; higher: in waves along it
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.tideWet: How long the ground stays wet
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.rush: How much the river speeds up toward an edge
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.rapids: White water all down the river, more where it runs fast or hits a bank or a stone
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.streaks: Light streaks where the river runs fast, toward an edge
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.rangle: Which way a river runs where no fall pulls it, in degrees
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.rnet: The river's net of light sliding down the flow
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.rcell: Cell size of the river's net
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.banks: The river's shore line and foam along its banks
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.rdepth: Darker deep water in the middle of the river
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.rpatches: Darker patches drifting down the river
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.mouthFoam: How tall the white water over the edge is (0: no mouth band)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.mouthFringe: How long the streaks hanging from it into the curtain are
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.mouthTeeth: How far the blue teeth reach up into the river
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.mouthWave: How far the columns bob up and down (0: still)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.mouthRagged: 0: the lengths change smoothly along the edge; 10: every column its own
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.fallStyle: How the falling water is drawn
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.speed: How fast the water falls (it speeds up on the way down)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.lines: Thin light strands running down the curtain
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.weave: Strands woven into long cells, like a ladder of light
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.gaps: Dark gaps under the edge where the curtain splits
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.top: The mouth's white band on a fall with no water over it
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.arcs: Bands sagging across the fall from its lip, darkening and breaking up on the way down
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.edges: Outlines on the sides; higher: ragged sides and drops breaking off
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.shading: Rounds the curtain: lighter toward the light
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.light: Which side the light comes from
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.ripples: Ripples spreading from where a fall lands
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.reflect: The fall upside down in the water under it
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.trail: Foam carried away from a landing, down the stream
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.guideOn: Use the rods you drew to steer the water and shape the edges
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.guideStrength: How much the water turns to follow a rod (10: wholly, on the rod)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.guideReach: How far from a rod the water still turns (px)
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.guideFoam: The foam flecks carried along the rods
MOINENMAPS.Water.h.px: Scene pixels per art pixel. Smaller is finer, and slower to bake
MOINENMAPS.Water.pxInfo: {w} × {h} art pixels, about {s} s to bake

MOINENMAPS.Night.previewHint: While this section is open, the district shows its lights as at night.
MOINENMAPS.Night.scenePreviewHint: While this section is open, the viewed scene shows its lights as at night. Districts can set their own look in their editor.
MOINENMAPS.Night.ownHint: Off: this district uses the scene's night-light look.
MOINENMAPS.Night.sceneOnHint: The default for every district that does not choose for itself.
MOINENMAPS.Night.modeHint: Always night and Never ignore the darkness slider, handy for testing.
MOINENMAPS.Night.startHint: Darkness level at which the first lights come on.
MOINENMAPS.Night.fullHint: Darkness level at which every light is on.
MOINENMAPS.Night.styleHint: Windows line up with the district's longest edge, like houses along a street.
MOINENMAPS.Night.glowHint: How far each light brightens the dark map around it.
MOINENMAPS.Night.switchingHint: How many lights go out for a while and come back.
MOINENMAPS.Dots.sizeHint: Largest dot, as a share of the spacing. Near 1 the dots touch.
MOINENMAPS.Dots.spacingHint: Distance between dots, in grid squares.
MOINENMAPS.Dots.gradIn: Small at the edge, large inside
MOINENMAPS.Dots.gradOut: Large at the edge, small inside
MOINENMAPS.Dots.tintHint: A faint wash of the district colour behind the dots.
MOINENMAPS.Dots.overprintHint: A subtle darker screen at another angle, like an off-register print.
MOINENMAPS.Tok.enabledHint: A token placed on this scene falls onto the map and squishes on impact. Only a visual effect; nothing is saved on the token.
MOINENMAPS.Tok.hopHint: A small hop while a token is being moved.
MOINENMAPS.Tok.intensityHint: Scales the hop, the lock-on squeeze and the reticle's idle motion.
MOINENMAPS.Tok.hideHint: A hidden token leaves a ghost that puffs away (so players see it go); a revealed token pops in. Vision changes are not animated.
MOINENMAPS.Tok.targetHint: A hand-inked reticle snaps onto a targeted token with a punchy squeeze, idles while it is targeted, and spins out when released.
MOINENMAPS.Tok.reticleUserHint: Off: every reticle uses the colour below.
MOINENMAPS.Tok.hideNativeHint: Off: the reticle is added next to Foundry's indicator.
MOINENMAPS.Tok.combatHint: Combatants hop with a shockwave when they join a combat, and the whole field wakes up, highest initiative first, when it starts.
MOINENMAPS.Setting.respectMotionHint: When your operating system asks for reduced motion, also stand still the pin, district and token animations. Off by default: these are gameplay effects.
MOINENMAPS.Setting.debugHint: Log to the browser console (debug level) why an animation did not play.
MOINENMAPS.Setting.perfModeHint: What this computer draws (only for you). High: everything. Medium: damage enters only on screen, fewer particles. Low: entries are short fades, no drifting dust or embers, no water reflections, at most 15 cars, lights do not twinkle.
MOINENMAPS.Setting.destructionCacheHint: Draw the damage that does not move from a ready image instead of tens of thousands of pieces every frame (much faster). Turn off only to compare or to rule it out.
MOINENMAPS.Setting.smoothZoomHint: The mouse wheel glides the zoom to where it is going instead of jumping 5% per notch; a fast spin or a trackpad zooms in one smooth motion. Off: Foundry's own wheel zoom. Not used while EZGlide is on (it glides the zoom itself).
MOINENMAPS.Setting.framePacingHint: On a display faster than Foundry's frame cap (e.g. 144 or 165 Hz with 60 fps) Foundry draws frames at uneven gaps, so animations and zooming judder although the fps is high. Even: about the same cap, every frame the same time apart (165 Hz with Foundry's 60 fps cap: 55 fps; 144 Hz: 72; with no cap - performance mode Maximum - every refresh, nothing is lowered). Display: every refresh of the display (165 fps, more GPU). Foundry: as Foundry does it.
MOINENMAPS.Setting.framePacingNow: Now: {mode}: {fps} fps on this display ({hz} Hz) with Foundry's frame cap {cap}.
MOINENMAPS.Setting.smoothWaterHint: The painted water's loop cross-fades from one baked frame into the next instead of stepping about 11 times a second, so it flows smoothly at any frame rate. Off: the frames step as baked (crisper, chunkier).

MOINENMAPS.WS.pinHint: Click: place · Shift+click: no snapping · Esc: done
MOINENMAPS.WS.selectHint: Click a pin to select it, drag to move it, double-click to edit it.
MOINENMAPS.WS.districtPickHint: Hover a district for its card, double-click it to edit it.
MOINENMAPS.WS.eraseHint: Erases from every district under the brush · [ and ]: size
MOINENMAPS.WS.filterEmpty: No visible pins on this scene (or pins are off in the scene's Pins tab).

MOINENMAPS.WS.rodHint: Drag: new rod · Del: remove the selected one · Ctrl+Z: undo
MOINENMAPS.Roads.title: Roads
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.width: Road width in grid squares (for a guide line: the width of the road on the map; cars keep to its lanes). [ and ] change it while painting.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.lanes: Two lanes get a dashed centre line; one lane is a narrow road.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.oneway: Cars drive only the way the road was painted. Alt+Shift-click a road to turn it around.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.eraser: Eraser size in grid squares. [ and ] change it.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.density: How many cars for the length of the roads.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.speed: 1 = about a grid square and a half per second on asphalt; cobbles and dirt are slower.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.size: Length of an ordinary car in grid squares.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.max: An upper limit on the number of cars, whatever the density.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.side: Which side of the road cars keep to.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.lights: Auto: on when the scene is dark.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.who: Players see the same cars at the same moment; or only the GM sees them.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.style: Inked like the map, or crisp pixel art.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.shadow: A soft shadow along the roads.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.clearConfirm: Remove every road of this scene? Ctrl+Z brings them back while the scene stays open.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.hintDraw: Drag to paint a road, or click point by point and double-click (or Enter) to finish; hold Shift for straight lines at 15° steps. Ends join nearby roads; crossings become junctions. To adopt a road drawn on the map, trace it as a Guide line (G switches): cars drive it and nothing is painted. Alt-click a road to give it this brush, right-click to delete it. [ ]: width, Ctrl+Z: undo.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.hintErase: Drag over roads to cut them. [ ]: eraser size, Ctrl+Z: undo.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.hintDrawShort: Drag or click points · Shift straight · double-click ends · G guide line · Alt-click restyles · right-click deletes · [ ] width
MOINENMAPS.Roads.hintEraseShort: Drag over roads to cut them · [ ] size · Ctrl+Z undo
MOINENMAPS.Roads.pickHint: Pick the road pen or the eraser.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.guides: Guide lines trace roads already drawn on the map: cars drive them, nothing is painted. Only the GM sees them, while a road tool is in hand or always.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.pickHint: Pick the damage brush to paint, or Detonate to replay the break for everyone.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.sizeHint: Brush diameter in grid squares ([ and ] change it)
MOINENMAPS.Destr.eraseHint: Paint over damage to repair it. Ctrl+Z undoes a stroke.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.levelHint1: Cracked: the surface stays, split by cracks (key 1)
MOINENMAPS.Destr.levelHint2: Broken: plates heave, tilt and part (key 2)
MOINENMAPS.Destr.levelHint3: Crater: the surface is torn away and thrown out (key 3)
MOINENMAPS.Destr.typeHint.blast: an explosion crater, debris thrown out, scorched rim
MOINENMAPS.Destr.typeHint.collapse: the floor falls in: slabs slump into a pit of darkness
MOINENMAPS.Destr.typeHint.flood: a hole that filled with water, plates sunk
MOINENMAPS.Destr.typeHint.gash: the surface ripped open along the stroke
MOINENMAPS.Destr.paintHint: Shift+stroke deepens one level. 1 2 3 level, Shift+0–9 cause (, and . step through), [ ] size, Ctrl+Z undo. Ctrl+drag from a token carries it along the stroke.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.causeHint.none: no cause of its own: it follows the scene's default cause, or shows the kind's plain look
MOINENMAPS.Destr.causeHint.fire: charred ground, glowing fissures and embers, a burnt halo; glows in the dark
MOINENMAPS.Destr.causeHint.acid: eaten, pitted edges, pools of acid with bubbles, a green stain; a faint glow
MOINENMAPS.Destr.causeHint.lightning: branching burn lines, fused glassy ground, sparks; glows in the dark
MOINENMAPS.Destr.causeHint.arcane: a rune circle, spiralling cracks, motes and odd colours; glows in the dark
MOINENMAPS.Destr.causeHint.impact: a hard blow (meteor, giant fist): radial fractures, a pressed rim, dust
MOINENMAPS.Destr.causeHint.claws: beasts and blades: torn in strips, parallel scratches running past the damage
MOINENMAPS.Destr.causeHint.water: erosion: scoured smooth edges, sediment bands, puddles, a wet halo
MOINENMAPS.Destr.causeHint.decay: slow ruin: moss, roots in the cracks, mould, a crumbling edge
MOINENMAPS.Destr.causeHint.frost: ice in the hole, crystal cracks at sharp angles, frost rime around
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.cause: What caused the damage, for every stroke painted with the cause "Scene default". A stroke with its own cause keeps it; change one stroke's cause in the Damage list.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.empty: No damage on this scene yet. Pick the brush and paint.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.clearConfirm: Remove all damage from this scene?
MOINENMAPS.Destr.enabledHint: Hide the damage without losing it
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.material: What lies under the surface. Auto reads it from the map's colours and grain.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.debris: How much of a crater's surface survives as pieces (the rest is pulverised)
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.lift: How steeply broken plates tilt and lift
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.rubble: Stones and chips in the hole
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.halo: Scorch and dust on the intact ground around
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.anim: Pieces pop, fly and settle when damage is painted or detonated
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.idle: Now and then a puff of dust, embers over a burn, pebbles into a pit
MOINENMAPS.Destr.motionHint: Motion is cosmetic and honours Respect reduced motion.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.entry: New damage does not just appear: it tears open from the impact in its own way (blast, cave-in, fire front, water, fracture, claw swipe). Only new or changed areas play it; a reload shows everything settled.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.entryPower: How big the flash, the rings, the arcs of thrown pieces and the dust are
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.jagged: Much more broken outlines: bites and chipped teeth along the rim, torn-off fragments just outside it, angular shard cuts, branching hairline cracks
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.jag: How strongly the borders are torn
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.directional: The brush stroke matters: a long stroke becomes a ploughed furrow along its path, and its entry runs along the path in the order and at the speed it was drawn
MOINENMAPS.Destr.quickJagged: Torn borders (on/off) - applies to new strokes only
MOINENMAPS.Destr.quickDirectional: Follows the stroke (on/off) - off: everything detonates at once; applies to new strokes only
MOINENMAPS.Destr.quickCarryHint: Carry token: a stroke that begins on a token and is dragged carries the token along its path, in step with the blast. On: a plain drag from a token carries it, Ctrl+drag paints normally. Off: Ctrl+drag from a token carries it.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.carryArmedHint: Carry token is on: drag from a token to carry it along the stroke (Ctrl+drag paints normally).
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.carry: On: a stroke that begins on a token and is dragged carries the token along its path in step with the blast; Ctrl+drag then paints normally. Off: Ctrl+drag (left button) from a token carries it. A click carries nothing.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.carryEndsHint: Where a carried token ends up: it really moves to the end of the stroke (the token document changes; Ctrl+Z puts it back), or it only rides the stroke and returns.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.carrySnap: Snap the carried token to the grid
MOINENMAPS.Destr.carrySnapHint: A token that really moves ends centred on a grid cell.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.quickFreeHint: Ignore the grid: a carried token (and every token it pushes) ends exactly where the path ends, off the grid, with no snapping. Beats 'Snap the carried token to the grid'. Pushed tokens only keep clear of each other.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.free: On: no snapping at all. The token ends exactly where the stroke ends (free position, between cells) and so do the tokens it pushes, apart from the little room they need not to overlap. Beats 'Snap the carried token to the grid'. Off: the snap setting below decides.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.quickSuperHint: Superhero: a carried token ploughs through every token in its way. The first one it touches is picked up and pushed ahead of it, and what that one hits is pushed too (up to 12). Only works together with Carry token; with no carried token nothing happens. With 'Moves for real', Ctrl+Z puts them all back.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.superIgnoreHeightHint: Off (default): the plough only meets tokens at its own height; a token that hovers or flies (document elevation, a flying status or a moinen-pixel-vfx flight / levitation passive) is passed under or over. On: it ploughs hovering tokens too; they keep their own height all the way.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.h.super: On: the token you carry ploughs through the tokens on its path: each one it touches is pushed ahead of it like by a bulldozer, and passes the push on to the next. Locked and hidden tokens are left alone. With 'Moves for real' every pushed token ends where it was pushed (never two on one cell) and Ctrl+Z puts them all back; 'Returns' moves nobody. Needs Carry token; without a carried token nothing happens.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.oldLook.background: {n} stroke(s) in the look of bake {v}, updated in the background
MOINENMAPS.Destr.oldLook.ask: {n} stroke(s) in the look of bake {v}
MOINENMAPS.Destr.bakeNowHint: Bake and publish the damage again (after automatic baking was paused)
MOINENMAPS.Destr.rebakeAllHint: Bake the strokes still shown in an older look now, in the new look
MOINENMAPS.Destr.rebakeSetting: Damage: new look after an update
MOINENMAPS.Destr.rebakeSettingHint: When an update only changes details of the damage's look, the scene keeps showing the published look. Background: the new look is baked while this tab is idle and swapped in stroke by stroke. Ask: only on Rebake all in the Damage panel. Immediately: baked when the scene opens.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.compositeSettingHint: Opening a scene, show the damage from the picture of its settled look the GM's client published (a few files) and fetch a stroke's own data only when it is needed (an entry, a flooded hole, an undo, a dark scene). Off: every stroke is downloaded as before.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.threadsSettingHint: How many background threads bake the damage when a scene must be baked anew. Auto: the processor's cores minus two (2 to 8), only 2 in performance mode Low, in a hidden tab or on a low battery.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.olderLook: {n} stroke(s) keep the look of an older version ({from}, now {to}): Rebake all takes about {eta} s
MOINENMAPS.Destr.rebakeOne: Rebake this stroke in the current look
MOINENMAPS.Destr.bakePaused: Baking paused: the damage manifest keeps changing (clients on different versions?). Reload all Foundry tabs, then Bake now.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.notShown: Damage not displayed: {why}. Baking it here again.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.mixedLayout: A browser tab running an older version of the module saved this scene's damage. No stroke was dropped (both versions are merged), but reload every Foundry tab (F5) now.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.strokesGone: {n} of {total} published strokes are missing from the scene.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.snapshotKept: A save on {when} dropped {n} stroke(s) nobody undid; they are kept in the scene.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.backupHint: Bring them back with game.modules.get('moinen-maps').api.destruction.restoreBackup() (from: 'v3' the last snapshot, 'v2' the copy from before the format change).
MOINENMAPS.Destr.noBackup: This scene has no saved copy of its strokes.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.lookNewOnlyNotice: Look setting changed: it applies to strokes you paint from now on. Use "Apply to existing strokes" to change the ones already painted.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.lookNewOnly: These settings apply to strokes you paint from now on. Strokes already painted keep the look they were painted with (nothing is re-rendered).
MOINENMAPS.Destr.applyLookHint: Bake the strokes already painted again with the settings above
MOINENMAPS.Destr.applyLookConfirm: Paint all existing strokes again with these settings? They are baked again in the background.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.applyLookDone: {n} strokes will take the new settings
MOINENMAPS.Destr.publishFailed: Moinen Maps: the destruction could not be saved to the world folder; players will bake it themselves.
MOINENMAPS.Flood.publishFailed: Moinen Maps: the water of the flooded holes could not be saved to the world folder; players will bake it themselves.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.roadSpeed: How fast cars drive this road, relative to its kind (1 = normal).
MOINENMAPS.Roads.h.vary: Cars differ in size by up to this much, at random.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.editPick: Click a road to edit its shape and settings.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.hintEdit: Click a road to select it. Drag a point to bend the road (an end joins a road or junction it is dropped on), drag the line for a new point (a click adds one there), right-click a point or press Delete to remove it, double-click a point for a sharp corner. Shift-drag the line to move the road, Shift-drag a dead end to extend it. [ ]: width, Delete: the road, Ctrl+Z: undo.
MOINENMAPS.Roads.hintEditShort: Drag points · drag the line: new point · right-click: remove · double-click: corner · Shift: move / extend · [ ] width
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.settingHint: Off: no token animations at all on this screen (enter, leave, idle, death, drop, reticle, combat entry). Only your screen; nothing is stored.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.enterDesc.drop: Falls onto the map, squashes and bounces.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.enterDesc.classic: A small, soft pop from just below full size.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.enterDesc.fade: Fades in while dust rises round its feet.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.enterDesc.pop: Pops out of nothing with a squash and a few sparkles.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.enterDesc.materialise: Its pixels fly in from round about and settle into it.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.enterDesc.warp: A beam of light comes down, a flash, and it stands there.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.enterDesc.slide: Slides in from the nearest edge of the scene, kicking up dust.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.enterDesc.rise: Grows up out of the ground; clods fall off it.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.enterDesc.portal: A swirl of pixels opens and it spins out of it.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.leaveDesc.puff: Squashes and puffs away in a ring of little clouds.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.leaveDesc.dissolve: Falls apart into its own pixels, which drift up and blink out.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.leaveDesc.fade: Fades out with a little dust.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.leaveDesc.shrink: Stretches, shrinks to a point and pops with a sparkle.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.leaveDesc.warp: A beam pulls it up into the sky.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.leaveDesc.burst: Bursts into confetti of its own colours.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.leaveDesc.smoke: Vanishes behind a puff of pixel smoke.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.leaveDesc.slide: Slides off towards the nearest edge of the scene.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.idleDesc.breathe: A slow breath: a little taller, a little narrower.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.idleDesc.bob: Floats up and down by a pixel or two.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.idleDesc.sway: Leans slowly from side to side.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.idleDesc.hover: Floats above the ground; its shadow pulses.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.idleDesc.flicker: Now and then flickers, like a bad hologram.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.idleDesc.wiggle: Still, until the pointer is over it.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.deathDesc.none: No animation; only the corpse look (if any).
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.deathDesc.fall: Staggers, topples over sideways and bounces in a puff of dust.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.deathDesc.grey: The colour drains away and a skull rises.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.deathDesc.disintegrate: Crumbles into grey ash that blows away.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.deathDesc.explode: Swells and bursts into sparkles and a bone-white puff. No gore.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.deathDesc.soul: A pale wisp of it rises and fades.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.deathDesc.petrify: Turns to grey stone; cracks spread over it.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.corpseHint: How a dead token looks from then on (also after a reload: the death is never played again).
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.corpse.body: Body: lies as it fell, grey, skull
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.pickFirst: Pick one or more tokens first (the pointer tool of the Tokens bar, or the list in the dock).
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.barStyleHint: The scene's style for this effect. It plays on the picked tokens as you choose it.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.speedHint: Tempo of the enter, leave and death animations.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.playHint: Play this effect on the picked tokens, on your screen only. Nothing is stored.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.applyPickedHint: Give the picked tokens this style as their own (an override of the scene's style).
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.pickHint: Click a token to pick it, Shift+click to add
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.clientNote: Each player can switch token effects off for their own screen (module settings), and Performance mode Low plays only short fades.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.placedOn: Animate tokens placed on the map
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.placedOnHint: A new token (created here or dragged in from the sidebar) enters with the style below.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.leaveNote: Played on a copy of the token: the deletion itself is never delayed. A token that died does not leave again.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.idleWhenHint: Idle pauses while another effect plays on the token and while it is dragged.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.idleTurnHint: The combatant whose turn it is moves a little more and glows.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.idleNote: Off in Performance mode Low and with reduced motion. Tokens off screen are not animated.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.deathOnHint: When a token becomes dead or defeated, on every screen. Nothing is written to the token.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.detectDefeated: It is marked defeated in the combat tracker
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.detectHpHint: Read from the actor property below. In Invincible, health 0 means broken, not dead: leave this off there unless you want that.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.hpPathNone: This game system has no known hit points property: type it in.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.overrides: Own styles of the picked tokens
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.applyAllHint: Give every token of the scene the own styles of the first picked token.
MOINENMAPS.TokFx.sceneLink: Enter, leave, idle and death styles, and per-token styles, are in the Tokens workspace.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.title: Cinematic
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.hintOptOut: Your own choice on top of the scene: an effect plays only when the scene has it on and you have not turned it off.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.modeHint: Which new damage is staged: hidden from the players (and from you, without the preview) until you press Action!
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.previewHint: You see staged damage at once (with a thin outline); the players do not.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.actionHint: Play the staged damage for everyone, in order, as a show
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.killed: Cinematic mode is switched off for this world (CONFIG.moinenMaps.noCinematic): everything shows at once.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.offHint: Off: new damage shows as soon as it is painted.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.aspect: Sets the bar height so that a screen like yours is cropped to this picture ratio.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.preset: A shipped or saved set of values. Changing a value below keeps the preset and marks it with *.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.fx: Master switch: off turns every screen effect off (the destruction itself is not affected).
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.ioHint: Paste a preset JSON here, then press Import.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.importBad: That is not a valid cinematic preset.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.camAuto: Automatic (players follow the show, the GM stays)
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.reducedHint: Reduced motion turns off shake, slow motion, flashes and the camera. Automatic follows your system setting.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.lbHeight: Each bar, as a share of the screen height.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.lbIn: How long the bars take to slide in.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.lbOut: How long the bars take to slide out.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.lbEase: The speed curve of the bars.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.vgRadius: How much of the screen stays clear; smaller means more shade.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.flIntensity: How bright the flash starts. Small hits flash at about half of this.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.flDur: How long the flash takes to fade.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.shIntensity: Share of the maximum offset. Small hits shake at about half.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.shDecay: Higher means the shake dies out sooner.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.shBias: How much the shake follows the direction of the damage.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.shMax: The largest shift of the picture, in screen pixels.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.smFactor: How slow the entry becomes on a big hit (1 is normal speed). Affects the entries that start in the window.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.smThreshold: Only hits at least this big slow the show.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.camMode: Follow moves with each stroke; frame shows the whole damage at once.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.camZoomMin: Zoom relative to the view when the show starts.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.camZoomMax: Never more than 4 times or less than half of the start zoom.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.camLead: How far ahead of the front the camera aims.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.camAhead: How much earlier than the impact the camera sets off for the stroke, so it is there when the hit lands (0 = it moves only with the impact).
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.camHold: How long the camera stays after the last impact.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.camReturn: Time to go back to the previous view.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.camEase: 0 is a linear move, 1 is fully eased.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.pace: As painted keeps your own pauses; dramatic uses the gap below.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.timeScale: Speeds up (above 1) or slows down (below 1) all the pauses of the show.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.gap: Pause between two staged strokes (doubled after a big hit).
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.pauseBefore: Time between the bars sliding in and the first impact.
MOINENMAPS.Destr.cin.h.pauseAfter: Time after the last impact before the show ends.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.sizeHint: Brush diameter in grid squares ([ and ]).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.strengthHint: How fierce: taller flames, denser smoke. Kept on the stroke.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.windHint: How hard the wind bends the smoke (0 = it rises straight up). Kept on the stroke.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.paintHint: Drag to paint flames over the map. Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z redo.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.smokeHint: Drag to paint smoke: it rises, drifts with the wind and thins out.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.eraseHint: Drag to put out fire and smoke painted before (only this layer).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.empty: Nothing burns. Pick the fire or smoke brush and paint on the map.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.clearConfirm: Remove every fire and smoke stroke of this scene?
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.on: Off hides the layer for everyone; the strokes stay.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.flame: How tall the flames lick, for every fire of the scene.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.plume: How far smoke travels before it is gone, in grid squares.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.smoke: How much smoke the fire gives off on its own (0 = none).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.speed: How fast the flames, smoke and embers move.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.light: Light sources of Foundry's own lighting (not saved as lights): they light the ground and tokens in dark scenes and are blocked by walls.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.lightRadius: The light's reach, as a multiple of the burning area's size.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.lightIntensity: How bright the fire light is.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.lightFlicker: How much the light flickers (0 = steady). The same on every screen.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.lightColor: The colour of the fire light when it does not follow the fire's colour.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.lvlHint1: Level 1: a smouldering, glowing bed with low, sparse flames (key 1).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.lvlHint3: Level 3: a blaze - tall, dense flames, more sparks, a stronger light (key 3).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.smkHint1: Level 1: thin, light wisps (Shift+1; the smoke brush: 1).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.smkHint2: Level 2: a steady plume (Shift+2; the smoke brush: 2).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.smkHint3: Level 3: a thick, dark, billowing column (Shift+3; the smoke brush: 3).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.styHint.fire: Fire burning in place: a glowing base on the ground, tongues licking up from it.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.styHint.fireball: Fireball: the rolling ball of fire (the layer's first look).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.spread: How fast a new stroke catches along its path (grid squares a second).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.grow: Seconds the flames take to grow to full height (the smoke builds up after them).
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.out: Seconds the flames take to go out; the embers glow on a moment and the smoke lingers after them.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.colHint.scene: The scene's fire colour (set in the Fire and smoke panel); the stroke follows it if it changes.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.colHint.blue: Blue gas flames: a pale cyan core, indigo tips.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.colHint.custom: Any colour: the whole palette (core, flames, tips, embers, light) is derived from it.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.fireColor: The colour of strokes painted with the brush colour 'Scene' (and of older strokes). The whole palette is derived from it.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.smokeTint: 0: neutral grey smoke. Higher: the smoke takes on its fire's colour.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.torn: New fire and smoke strokes get a torn, ragged footprint: lobes, inlets, chipped bites and a few detached islands near the edge (as destruction's torn borders). Each stroke keeps the setting it was painted with.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.tear: How torn the edges of new strokes are.
MOINENMAPS.Fire.quickTorn: Torn edges (on/off) - applies to new strokes only
MOINENMAPS.Fire.tornOn: Torn edges: on (click to turn off for this stroke)
MOINENMAPS.Fire.tornOff: Torn edges: off (click to turn on for this stroke)
MOINENMAPS.Fire.h.lightFollow: Each fire lights in its own colour. Off: every fire uses the light colour below.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.trimHint: Trim: cut away every bit of line that does not bound a zone
MOINENMAPS.Zones.hintDraw: Drag to draw freely, Shift for a straight line. Any area the lines close off is a zone; lines may stick out.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.hintErase: Drag over lines to rub them out. [ ] eraser size.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.hintPick: Pick the pencil to draw zone borders.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.h.snap: A line that stops this close (in squares) to another line is joined to it.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.h.preset: How movement in zones is counted and what it costs.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.presetInfo.none: The distance is the number of zone borders on the shortest route.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.presetInfo.invincible: Distance = borders on the shortest route. On foot a quick action moves 1 zone (two quick actions: 2 zones, no full action). Movement powers: 2 zones per action (4 with 1 stress); Major 4/8, Massive 8/16, Monstrous 16/32.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.h.who: Outside this panel only the finished zones show (never the pencil lines).
MOINENMAPS.Zones.h.distances: With one token selected, every zone shows how many zones away it is and what reaching it costs.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.h.ruler: While dragging a token the ruler shows zones instead of squares.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.clearAsk: Remove every zone line of this scene? (Ctrl+Z brings them back while the scene is open.)
MOINENMAPS.Zones.h.numbers: On hover: only the zone under the cursor shows its number. Distances around a selected token always show.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.h.smooth: Smooths the zone borders (the pencil lines stay as drawn). 0 = exactly as drawn.
MOINENMAPS.Zones.h.hoverHi: The zone under the cursor lights its border and shows the effect below.
